name: Silver, as plated on a daguerreotype's copper

f0.source: Akenine-Moller, Haines, Hoffman et al., Real-Time Rendering, 4th ed. (2018), Table 9.2 (silver's F0 in linear sRGB, from measured n and k)
f0.note: The values as that table quotes them; its measured constants (Johnson and Christy 1972) were not read in this pass.

f82.source: no measured reflectance of silver at 82 degrees was read
f82.note: Silver's absorption index is high across the visible, so its reflectance barely dips before grazing: taken equal to F0 until n and k are read.
